word.item: Greetings to all greetings greetings again greetings yes I am called Margaret Muheche.
There was a poor person we had one person and that person was poor.
That person was walking he walked and walked as he looked for work.
He walked for many days until even the clothes got torned and remained rugs.
But the time that he was walking.
He reached somewhere and found they had written there we have work but there is no salary.
That person thought and asked himself.
He said if they are saying there is work here.
And there is no salary what will I do.
And since I have walked for many days I have walked the clothes are torn I have remained naked.
He decided and said I will enter even though there is no salary I will enter and just do work.
And the time when he entered they opened for him the gate he went and passed the first gate he passed the second gate.
When he got to the third gate he entered when he entered he found the people were inside they welcomed him.
When they welcomed him he found the boss.
When he found the boss that boss welcomed him he told his workers take him there you give him water.
He bath you give him clothes they gave him water he bathed he took his rugs.
They told him to take his rugs and go to throw them away they gave him clothes to put on he put them on.
And him when they asked him to go and throw them away he did not go to throw them he took his rugs and went to hide.
He hid and then he began to do work he did the work he did the work.
He leavsa and goes to take his rugs from where he hid them he removes the clothes that the boss gave him.
He goes and put on his rugs when he puts on his rugs he looks at himself.
He looks at himself he takes again he removes he takes his rugs and puts them there.
Again he puts on clothes and there was one time.
Because that boss was coming as he walks as he walks as he monitors his workers how they are doing work.
The time that he was walking and that one has done the work he did not know the boss was coming.
And the time that he had finished work he left and went somewhere where where he kept his rugs.
And the time that the boss was walking he came and wondered aai.
Eee on my farm this route is for what.

When that boss came and found him he just told him be the way you are.
Just stay with your clothes like that.
That story means what it means.
We christians the time that you live you are struggling you are struggling.
